headline: Infineon graduate role pairs analog behavioral modeling with AI verification methodology
fact: Infineon advertised an Andover Regional Graduate Program – Engineer Verification and Validation role for computing power-management products, with a retained September 3 listing. It assigns AI-based verification-flow improvement for coverage and documentation, alongside Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog behavioral models, schematic correlation, targeted testbenches and analog/digital integration debug. The AI duty is an assigned methodology task; the posting does not say that AI generates those models. This is distinct from the later general AMS internship advertisements.
